Beluga (00)

Huso huso Marky's | USA
From: $155
Item #010101P

This rare Malossol caviar comes from American-farmed purebred Beluga (Huso huso) sturgeon. Its large, firm, medium gray pearls are packed with a deliciously buttery, creamy, nutty taste that provides a unique, full-flavored finish.

Before placing an order for this caviar, please read this short notice.

Approximate shipping time is 1 business day

This product is perishable and will be shipped by Overnight Shipping.

If you place your order today before 2 PM Eastern Time, its earliest possible delivery date is Thu, October 29, 2026. Otherwise, it may take an extra day for it to be delivered.

Quick Summary

Marky’s Beluga Caviar ( Huso huso , Grade 00, farmed) — 0.5 oz (14 g) to 35.3 oz (1 kg) glass jar or metal tin, by Sturgeon AquaFarms, from USA.

Additional Info

  • Farm raised in Bascom, Florida.
  • Large, firm, medium gray pearls with hints of black.
  • Fine, smooth, and delicate texture.
  • Deliciously nutty, creamy, and buttery flavor.
  • Excellent served alone on a Mother of Pearl spoon.

For the first time since 2005, purebred Caspian Beluga caviar is finally available in the US thanks to Sturgeon Aquafarms, LLC, America's exclusive aquafarm raising Beluga sturgeon. Native to the Caspian Sea, Beluga have the largest and most delicate eggs of all sturgeon, resulting in caviar that provides an incredible pop.

In 2003, SAF began to import Beluga and other sturgeon species to raise domestically, and in 2005, the US banned all imports of Beluga and its caviar due to the decline in its wild populations. Since 2009, Sturgeon Aquafarms has been successfully breeding Beluga and four other sturgeon species in Bascom, Florida. Now, a decade and a half later and at the culmination of a journey that began 40 years ago, our authentic Beluga caviar is finally available for sale in the United States.

As the only company currently in possession of this critically endangered species in this hemisphere, we are in a unique position not only in the United States but also globally to help restore its wild populations thanks to our successful breeding methods. Our focus has now grown to include assisting in re-population efforts, the transfer of technology through joint international agreements, and the development of successful captive breeding techniques for these unique species.

Discover more about America's exclusive aquafarm hosting Beluga sturgeon in Florida and the intricacies of Beluga caviar's sustainable manufacturing in the US from Business Insider's video:

Preparation

Fresh, cured with salt (Malossol).

Species

Huso huso, farmed. A CITES certificate is required to export this product outside the United States.

Packaging

Vacuum-sealed glass jar or metal tin.

Ingredients

Fish Roe, Salt.

Shipping

This product requires refrigeration during transit and will be shipped via Overnight shipping.

Storage Type

Keep refrigerated below 38 °F (3.3 °C). Do not freeze. Consume within 6-8 weeks from the date of purchase if in a glass jar or 3-4 weeks if in a metal tin, or 2-3 days once opened.

Net Weight

0.5 oz (14 g) to 35.3 oz (1 kg).

Allergy and Cautionary Information

Contains Fish. Consuming raw or unpasteurized seafood may increase your risk of foodborne illness, especially if you have certain medical conditions.

Advantages

Gluten-free. America's exclusive purebred Caspian Beluga Huso huso caviar.

Please Be Aware

  • Our caviars come in glass jars or metal tins, depending on availability. Due to high demand during the holiday season, we are temporarily unable to honor requests for caviar to be packed in a container of your choice. We appreciate your understanding and apologize for any inconvenience.
  • If you need your caviar by a specific date, we strongly recommend scheduling its delivery at least 2-3 days in advance to avoid potential shipping delays. When kept refrigerated below 38 °F (3.3 °C), unopened caviar has up to a 3-4 week shelf life if in a metal tin, or 6-8 weeks if in a glass jar. Once opened, it's best to consume it within 2-3 days.
